en.summary: Thrush often causes itch and thick white discharge. NHS: pharmacy advice for typical uncomplicated cases; see a GP if pregnant, recurrent, unsure, severe, or with pelvic pain/fever (could be another infection). No inventing prescription antifungals.
emergencyIf: Severe pelvic pain with fever (not typical simple thrush)
seeDoctorIf: Blood in discharge or foul smell suggesting other infection
selfCare: Loose cotton underwear; avoid irritants; ask pharmacist about over-the-counter options where appropriate
doNot: Do not invent oral antifungal doses
Do not assume STI treatment without testing when risk factors present

fr.summary: La mycose provoque souvent démangeaisons et pertes blanches épaisses. Conseil pharmacien si typique ; médecin si grossesse, récidives, doute, douleur pelvienne/fièvre.
selfCare: Sous-vêtements coton ; éviter irritants ; avis pharmacien

he.summary: פטרייה גורמת לרוב לגרד והפרשה לבנה סמיכה. ייעוץ בית מרקחת אם טיפוסי; רופא בהריון, חוזר, ספק, כאב אגן/חום.

ru.summary: Молочница часто даёт зуд и густые белые выделения. Совет фармацевта если типично; врач при беременности, рецидивах, сомнении, тазовой боли/лихорадке.
